rule: Server, every update interval, on a slow-job thread: per cell, pressure from two octaves of turbulent noise over space and time, offset by humidity; cloud = (1 - pressure) squared times a gain; rain = ((1 - pressure - threshold) * humidity * gain) to a power below one; wind per axis = cubed noise times a gain times (1 - pressure), so calm air with rare gusts. Lightning candidates are cells over rain and cloud thresholds; strikes per frame scale with candidates times delta time. The whole grid is compressed and prepared once for all clients; wind is sent per entity on a modulus stagger. Client: thunder volume falls with distance to the seventh power and is delayed by distance over the speed of sound; the lightning flash decays from the last strike. Time: game time advances at real time times a day-cycle coefficient (real minutes per game day); sun is one arc in one plane; four day-period buckets; the client chases the server time and snaps on a large gap that depends on the flashing-lights setting.
keep: Weather as a grid of cloud, rain and wind values built from noise, updated on a slow cadence
Pressure and humidity split: humidity gates how much rain a cloud can give
Cubed wind noise: calm air with rare gusts, which reads as a beat
Lightning as a server outcome with a client-only flash that decays from the strike
Thunder volume by distance with a delay of distance over the speed of sound
Staged music filter by day period, weather kind, site and biome, with fallback
Time-of-day snap threshold tied to the flashing-lights setting
Per-entity wind update on a modulus stagger
change: D1: flash gate sin(time_of_day seconds * 0.4) makes the flash pulse at about 0.16 s real; gate the flash by time since strike only
D2: clamp cloud to 0..1 in the sim so the kind thresholds and the client agree (latent, needs near-zero humidity)
D3: thunder hard gate at rain intensity 0.7 steps volume 0 to 0.7; ramp it
D4: candidate pick walks the whole list per strike; pick a random index
Send only zones whose weather changed (dirty set), not the whole grid every update
Lightning and rain never change damage, hit chance, input or the telegraph; server publishes state, client presents
look_test: Preview-only flag on the 3-attacker arena with a clear and a storm preset, lightning on a fixed 20 s timer and one wind gust; publish to /preview/ with no release rows. Compare clear and storm stills at the fight camera at 375 wide with three attackers in view, plus a short clip of one flash. Dom checks that the flash clears inside 0.3 s without hiding a telegraph or threat colour, that rain streaks do not mask silhouettes, and that the thunder bed does not cover combat sound cues.
